text: {"observations":"Broadband noise band above ~3 kHz runs from 0 to ~3.4 s and again ~3.8 to 8.8 s, steady and hiss-like, covering most of the clip. Harmonic voiced speech (stacked harmonics below ~1 kHz) appears only in shorter bursts at ~0.3-3.7 s, 4.2-5.0 s and 5.8-6.8 s. Descending chirp-like sweeps at ~0.3-0.8 s and ~6.0-6.5 s are brief. This rules in Hiss (D) as longest and rules out speech (A), chirp (B) and rustle (C).","answer":"D"}
